nodes.description: External HTTP caller or operator issuing a liveness/readiness probe: curl, a container healthcheck, or an orchestrator probe. The endpoint is unauthenticated, so no bearer key is required.
Single-process ASGI HTTP server bound to settings.host:settings.port. Accepts the probe connection and hands the ASGI HTTP scope to the FastAPI app.
FastAPI ASGI application assembled by create_app; matches the request path to a registered route and serializes the handler result to JSON.

Async route handler registered for GET /health/liveliness and GET /health/readiness (both decorators stack on the same function). Returns {"status": "ok"} unconditionally and consults neither gateway settings nor backends.
Configured backend model replicas (domain.Endpoint) reached in normal chat traffic through the BackendTransport port. Included only to record the readiness probe that is expected but never performed.

links.description: GET /health/liveliness or GET /health/readiness over HTTP; unauthenticated.
ASGI HTTP scope (method, path) delivered to the app.
Route match dispatches to async health(); both health paths map to the same handler.
HTTP 200 with {"status": "ok"} returned to the caller.

Absent interaction: health() never probes replica reachability, readiness, or configuration, so /health/readiness cannot report a degraded state. Annotated rather than called because no runtime message is ever exchanged.
